subject.title: fix(zai): send current GLM thinking params

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's Z.ai provider-wire change from `enable_thinking` to `thinking.type` plus gated `reasoning_effort` based on current docs, tests, and BigModel live proof?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but provider payload contracts can break real Z.ai users if host behavior differs, and the acceptance threshold for that risk is maintainer-owned.

options.title: Accept Current Contract
options.body: Merge this PR after normal landing checks because both builders are aligned and the redacted live GLM-5.2 proof matches the official documented contract.

options.title: Require Overseas Host Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted `api.z.ai` GLM-5.2 run before merge if maintainers want host-specific confidence beyond BigModel CN proof.

options.title: Use Another Canonical Candidate
options.body: Pause this PR only if another linked PR lands first with equivalent two-builder coverage and proof.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Contract
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after normal landing checks because both builders are aligned and the redacted live GLM-5.2 proof matches the official documented contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent GLM-5.2 provider support, AI runtime extraction, and Z.ai/provider docs work make this the clearest owner route for provider-contract acceptance.
